Market today: Yields are ticking up, and traders are waiting for the jobs report. This is the main driver for your tech/chip-heavy book, as higher rates can pressure growth stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.52%) and SPAL (-31.77%) are still marked SELL and need attention. They are leveraged ETFs and decay, making them extra risky on margin.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield. It's the key macro factor influencing your sector.

Bottom line: Manage your risk on the leveraged names and watch the bond market.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL if they show further weakness; these leveraged ETFs are bleeding on margin.
Consider trimming SMH (-4.27%) if it breaks below its stop at 540.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
